jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Post-Training — Collective Alignment (User Signals)
jobs.description:
Post-training - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT.

Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training.

**About the Role**

As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time.

You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training.

This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users.

**In this role, you will:**

* Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals.
* Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post-training.
* Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods.
* Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real-world user outcomes.
* Analyze unexpected results, investigate discrepancies between evaluation metrics and user behavior, and develop hypotheses to guide further research.
* Evaluate tradeoffs and regressions to improve targeted model behaviors while preserving broader capabilities.
* Collaborate with research, alignment, product, and data science teams.
* Implement and debug experiments across large-scale deep learning research systems.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have a strong background in deep learning research through academic or industry experience.
* Have demonstrated research ability through publications or substantive research contributions in deep learning or LLM post-training.
* Have experience developing new machine learning methods and evaluating them through rigorous, hypothesis-driven experimentation.
* Think critically about experimental design, measurement, and what evaluation results do and do not establish about model behavior.
* Are comfortable designing ablations, investigating surprising results, and reasoning about the relationship between offline metrics and real-world outcomes.
* Have strong programming skills and experience working with complex ML codebases.
* Are curious about how people interact with AI and how those interactions can inform better models.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with RLHF, reinforcement learning, or modern LLM post-training.
* Research or demonstrated interest in AI alignment, human feedback, or user signals.
* Experience with online experimentation, evaluation methodology, or learning from noisy and biased feedback.
* Experience connecting machine learning research with real-world product behavior.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Growth
jobs.description:
**About E2B**
=============

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.

### **About E2B**

E2B is a fast-growing Series A company with 9-figure revenue. We build the Agent Cloud: the infrastructure that AI labs and widely used consumer and enterprise agents run on, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy and Groq. The team includes original authors of Firecracker, the microVM technology behind AWS Lambda.

### **Why this role, why now**

E2B has started more than three billion sandboxes for over 200,000 teams, and 94 of the Fortune 100 have signed up. Almost all of it arrived inbound. What we don’t have is one trusted answer to basic questions: which teams are activated, which are about to become large customers, and what moved them there.

That’s the opportunity. The data exists; but much of it hasn't yet been converted into insights on how to grow the company. You'll be the first data scientist hire in growth. You’ll decide what the metrics mean, build the tables behind them, and do the analysis that sets what growth works on next.

This isn’t a role where clean tables arrive and you make charts. You’ll build your own pipelines, with AI tooling doing much of the typing, and you’ll own whether the numbers are right.

### **What you’ll own**

* *The account model.* One view of every team on E2B, from signup through first sandbox, paid conversion and expansion.
* *The definitions.* What “activated”, “active team” and “product-qualified account” mean. Every dashboard agrees because you settled it.
* *Experiments.* Design and readout for what growth engineering ships across signup, onboarding, docs and pricing.
* *Account scoring.* The signal that tells sales which self-serve teams look like enterprise customers.
* *Measurement for marketing.* Launches, lifecycle messaging, the startup program, events and partner integrations all get judged on your numbers.
* *Data quality.* When a number is wrong, you find out first and you fix it.

### **What’s already in place**

Growth engineering has instrumented the product and the site, so the raw events exist. Usage and billing data are there to be joined. A team of growth engineers and marketers is waiting to use what you build, and you report to the Chief Growth Officer.

### **First 90 days**

Map what data we have and what’s missing. Ship a first activation funnel and get growth, sales and finance to agree on the definitions. Get the account model live and trusted. Come back with the two or three biggest conversion opportunities and a measurable impact for each.

### **How we’ll judge year one**

Trust first: the company uses your metrics without arguing about them. Impact second: experiments read weekly on your model, account scoring feeding sales, and conversion gains you can trace to a decision your analysis drove. Self-serve third: routine questions can get answered without your direct input.

### **Who you are**

* You’ve been the first or an early data hire and built the foundations yourself.
* You’ve worked on a self-serve or usage-based product and know what activation and expansion look like in the data.
* Your SQL and Python are strong, and you’ve modeled raw product events and billing data into tables people trusted.
* You’ve designed experiments and read them honestly, including the inconclusive ones.
* You use AI coding and analysis tools every day and you check what they produce.
* You write clearly. An engineer, a marketer and the CEO can all act on your one-pager.
* Developer tools or infrastructure experience is a strong plus.

**What it’s like to work at E2B**
=================================

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.

Compensation Range: $180K - $260K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Tooling
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

  

### **How you'll make impact**

You’ll build AI tools and applications used by Airwallex employees, taking projects from inception through implementation. You’ll work across platform engineering, security, automation, and infrastructure to help teams operate more effectively.

* Lead the development of AI tools and applications from inception through implementation
* Build, monitor, and maintain infrastructure including Kubernetes clusters, serverless workloads, ETL pipelines, and terabyte-scale log pipelines
* Partner with engineers and product engineering teams to identify opportunities for automation and tooling development
* Support incident response by building tools for threat hunting, remediation, and security scanning
* Deliver security improvements such as automated patching, gateways, and other services that reduce risk
* Mentor Software Engineers and help grow the engineering team

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* Experience working with production codebases
* Experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, and one systems programming language, such as Go or C/C++
* Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, including data pipelines, serverless workloads, and Kubernetes
* A track record of working autonomously on projects and delivering high-quality work on time
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* The ability to dive deep to find the best solution to a problem
* Strong curiosity and a willingness to ask questions, gather context, and learn

**Preferred**

* Experience working in a high-growth technology company
* Hands-on experience with AI, specifically leveraging AI to build applications
* Experience maintaining Linux operating systems

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.
* You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.
* You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.
* You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

### **Learn more about your team**

InfoSec at Airwallex runs one of the most modern security teams in the world, protecting hundreds of thousands of customers and hundreds of billions of dollars. Our scale, funding, and industry make us a real target, so we skip the standard playbook of off-the-shelf tools and tiered SOC analysts and build almost everything ourselves, often with AI ahead of the rest of the industry. You'll go back to first principles constantly, because the off-the-shelf answer is rarely right for us, and we can build better than what already exists. If you want to build security from the ground up, against a real adversary, with people who are actually good at this, this is the team for you.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a software engineering team building AI systems for hospitality operations. You will own full-stack components that help resolve guest requests, from understanding intent and retrieving relevant information to coordinating tools and generating responses.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build response-generation pipelines that classify requests, assemble context, select tools, and decide when to respond or escalate.
* Develop retrieval systems that ground responses in accurate, current customer data.
* Create reliable orchestration for multi-step workflows, including recovery from third-party API failures.
* Build evaluation frameworks to assess quality against real conversations and catch regressions.
* Implement observability and tracing to make complex agent workflows understandable to support teams.
* Develop interfaces and controls that let support leads configure agent behavior without code.
* Extend the platform to voice with real-time transcription and tool use.
* Improve speed and cost through model routing, caching, and prompt refinement.
* Contribute across infrastructure, data pipelines, integrations, and APIs.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, with 5 or more years preferred.
* Relevant formal education in software engineering or a related field, along with hands-on software engineering experience.
* Full-stack capability across areas such as backend, frontend, infrastructure, and data pipelines, with proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Rust, or Java.
* Experience designing and debugging production AI or machine learning systems, including retrieval, prompt engineering, or model orchestration.
* Experience evaluating retrieval systems and building multi-step workflows, tool orchestration, or function-calling systems.
* Experience with production observability, tracing, testing, and evaluation for complex systems.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs and handling production failure modes.
* Real-time systems, voice or audio processing, end-user configuration tools, and model cost or latency optimization are useful additional experience.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

$130,000 to $220,000 base salary annually, plus 0.20% to 1.20% equity. Health insurance and a 401(k) match are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California.

Compensation Range: $130K - $220K

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how teams across the firm build AI agents by contributing to a high-visibility AI Agent Platform. You will work on core building blocks—such as the software development kit (SDK), orchestration patterns, reusable components, and quality tooling—that enable teams to create conversational, voice, and document-extraction agent experiences. You will help turn complex problems into dependable production systems, raise engineering standards, and improve accuracy and reliability through disciplined evaluation and iteration.

As a Software Engineer III – AI Agent Platform at JPMorganChase within Enterprise Technology, you will contribute to the design and delivery of platform capabilities that enable large-language-model-powered agents at scale. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product partners, and risk and security stakeholders to ship measurable improvements in performance, developer experience, and operational stability. You will learn continuously, contribute ideas, and help set a high bar for quality in systems used by many teams and users.

**Job responsibilities**

* Build core SDK features and reusable components that enable teams to compose and operate AI agents consistently and safely.
* Implement orchestration and tool/function-calling patterns that improve reliability, traceability, and developer experience.
* Develop retrieval and grounding capabilities that connect agents to approved data sources and reduce incorrect or unsupported responses.
* Create evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and quality metrics to measure capability accuracy and guide iterative improvements.
* Add testing, observability, and monitoring features (tracing, logs, latency and cost metrics) to improve operability and incident readiness.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate requirements into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Contribute to documentation, examples, and reference implementations that accelerate adoption and consistent usage.
* Participate in code reviews and design discussions to improve maintainability, performance, and overall engineering standards.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Two or more years of hands-on Python development experience delivering production software.
* Experience building and operating backend services or platform components with attention to reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* Experience writing automated tests and using version control and code review practices to maintain quality.
* Experience integrating application components with data sources and building robust error-handling and observability practices.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear deliverables, iterate quickly, and communicate trade-offs to partners.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a focus on outcomes and continuous improvement.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience building with large language model (LLM) application patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation and prompt iteration.
* Familiarity with evaluation approaches for LLM-enabled systems (offline evaluation, regression testing, and metric-driven iteration).
* Exposure to voice or speech-enabled experiences (speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or streaming interactions).
* Exposure to document processing approaches (for example, optical character recognition and structured field extraction).
* Experience with containerization and continuous integration/continuous delivery practices.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (for example, Amazon Web Services) and modern production operations practices.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

* *Measurement for marketing.* Launches, lifecycle messaging, the startup program, events and partner integrations all get judged on your numbers.
* *Data quality.* When a number is wrong, you find out first and you fix it.

### **What’s already in place**

Growth engineering has instrumented the product and the site, so the raw events exist. Usage and billing data are there to be joined. A team of growth engineers and marketers is waiting to use what you build, and you report to the Chief Growth Officer.

### **First 90 days**

Map what data we have and what’s missing. Ship a first activation funnel and get growth, sales and finance to agree on the definitions. Get the account model live and trusted. Come back with the two or three biggest conversion opportunities and a measurable impact for each.

### **How we’ll judge year one**

Trust first: the company uses your metrics without arguing about them. Impact second: experiments read weekly on your model, account scoring feeding sales, and conversion gains you can trace to a decision your analysis drove. Self-serve third: routine questions can get answered without your direct input.

### **Who you are**

* You’ve been the first or an early data hire and built the foundations yourself.
* You’ve worked on a self-serve or usage-based product and know what activation and expansion look like in the data.
* Your SQL and Python are strong, and you’ve modeled raw product events and billing data into tables people trusted.
* You’ve designed experiments and read them honestly, including the inconclusive ones.
* You use AI coding and analysis tools every day and you check what they produce.
* You write clearly. An engineer, a marketer and the CEO can all act on your one-pager.
* Developer tools or infrastructure experience is a strong plus.

**What it’s like to work at E2B**
=================================

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.

Compensation Range: $180K - $260K

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Tooling
new_jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

  

### **How you'll make impact**

You’ll build AI tools and applications used by Airwallex employees, taking projects from inception through implementation. You’ll work across platform engineering, security, automation, and infrastructure to help teams operate more effectively.

* Lead the development of AI tools and applications from inception through implementation
* Build, monitor, and maintain infrastructure including Kubernetes clusters, serverless workloads, ETL pipelines, and terabyte-scale log pipelines
* Partner with engineers and product engineering teams to identify opportunities for automation and tooling development
* Support incident response by building tools for threat hunting, remediation, and security scanning
* Deliver security improvements such as automated patching, gateways, and other services that reduce risk
* Mentor Software Engineers and help grow the engineering team

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* Experience working with production codebases
* Experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, and one systems programming language, such as Go or C/C++
* Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, including data pipelines, serverless workloads, and Kubernetes
* A track record of working autonomously on projects and delivering high-quality work on time
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* The ability to dive deep to find the best solution to a problem
* Strong curiosity and a willingness to ask questions, gather context, and learn

**Preferred**

* Experience working in a high-growth technology company
* Hands-on experience with AI, specifically leveraging AI to build applications
* Experience maintaining Linux operating systems

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.
* You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.
* You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.
* You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

### **Learn more about your team**

InfoSec at Airwallex runs one of the most modern security teams in the world, protecting hundreds of thousands of customers and hundreds of billions of dollars. Our scale, funding, and industry make us a real target, so we skip the standard playbook of off-the-shelf tools and tiered SOC analysts and build almost everything ourselves, often with AI ahead of the rest of the industry. You'll go back to first principles constantly, because the off-the-shelf answer is rarely right for us, and we can build better than what already exists. If you want to build security from the ground up, against a real adversary, with people who are actually good at this, this is the team for you.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer III - Agent Builder Platform
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how teams across the firm build AI agents by contributing to a high-visibility AI Agent Platform. You will work on core building blocks—such as the software development kit (SDK), orchestration patterns, reusable components, and quality tooling—that enable teams to create conversational, voice, and document-extraction agent experiences. You will help turn complex problems into dependable production systems, raise engineering standards, and improve accuracy and reliability through disciplined evaluation and iteration.

As a Software Engineer III – AI Agent Platform at JPMorganChase within Enterprise Technology, you will contribute to the design and delivery of platform capabilities that enable large-language-model-powered agents at scale. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product partners, and risk and security stakeholders to ship measurable improvements in performance, developer experience, and operational stability. You will learn continuously, contribute ideas, and help set a high bar for quality in systems used by many teams and users.

**Job responsibilities**

* Build core SDK features and reusable components that enable teams to compose and operate AI agents consistently and safely.
* Implement orchestration and tool/function-calling patterns that improve reliability, traceability, and developer experience.
* Develop retrieval and grounding capabilities that connect agents to approved data sources and reduce incorrect or unsupported responses.
* Create evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and quality metrics to measure capability accuracy and guide iterative improvements.
* Add testing, observability, and monitoring features (tracing, logs, latency and cost metrics) to improve operability and incident readiness.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate requirements into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Contribute to documentation, examples, and reference implementations that accelerate adoption and consistent usage.
* Participate in code reviews and design discussions to improve maintainability, performance, and overall engineering standards.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Two or more years of hands-on Python development experience delivering production software.
* Experience building and operating backend services or platform components with attention to reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* Experience writing automated tests and using version control and code review practices to maintain quality.
* Experience integrating application components with data sources and building robust error-handling and observability practices.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear deliverables, iterate quickly, and communicate trade-offs to partners.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a focus on outcomes and continuous improvement.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience building with large language model (LLM) application patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation and prompt iteration.
* Familiarity with evaluation approaches for LLM-enabled systems (offline evaluation, regression testing, and metric-driven iteration).
* Exposure to voice or speech-enabled experiences (speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or streaming interactions).
* Exposure to document processing approaches (for example, optical character recognition and structured field extraction).
* Experience with containerization and continuous integration/continuous delivery practices.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (for example, Amazon Web Services) and modern production operations practices.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
